rationales.seed_block: A disjoint 64-world development block estimates every paired open-assay effect.
rationales.recovery_seed_block: A disjoint 128-world block supports candidate, controllability, and broadcast calibration diagnostics.
rationales.sensitivity_seed_block: A disjoint 32-world block samples the local joint parameter neighborhood.
rationales.formation_structure_prior: A 0.22 persistent prior imposes a finite complexity penalty while leaving repeated coupled evidence able to win.
rationales.root_prior: A safety-favoring identity prior prevents formation from being assigned before evidence.
rationales.controllability_prior: Equal prior mass makes control an inferred property rather than a configured conclusion.
rationales.reflexive_broadcast_prior: Integrated broadcast is modestly expected while collapse remains plausible.
rationales.world_prior: A safety-favoring initial world prior separates isolated events from enduring danger.
rationales.self_root_coupling: A 0.90 persistent coupling is strong but noisy and becomes factorized in the transient candidate.
rationales.event_root_coupling: A 0.88 persistent event/root coupling permits event evidence to inform G without determinism.
rationales.event_base_likelihood: The symmetric 0.68 base likelihood is weak before precision modulation.
rationales.event_precision_support: Supports 0.7 and 3.0 make ordinary events modest and overwhelm sharply informative through the same likelihood.
rationales.broadcast_monitor_reliability: A 0.90 monitor supports recovery of reflexive broadcast without making it observed directly.
rationales.context_now_transient: A 0.92 now-context likelihood supplies strong but fallible evidence for a transient event when broadcast is integrated.
rationales.context_now_persistent: A 0.35 now-context likelihood penalizes persistent organization only when context is available.
rationales.outcome_observation_reliability: A 0.90 common outcome channel allows transition consequences to be observed with noise.
rationales.high_control_engage_recovery: An 0.84 recovery probability makes effective engagement visibly change the world.
rationales.high_control_avoid_threat: An 0.86 persistence probability makes avoidance capable of actively maintaining threat.
rationales.low_control_threat: A 0.72 action-invariant threat probability represents flattened policy consequences under low control.
rationales.real_danger_engage_threat: A 0.78 threat probability ensures persistence can be adaptive when danger is real despite engagement.
rationales.real_danger_avoid_threat: A 0.90 threat probability retains action dependence inside genuinely dangerous worlds.
rationales.policy_avoid_probabilities: Declared policy CPT rows make inferred G and C alter action probabilities without a policy write rule.
rationales.policy_consequence_prior: Symmetric Beta(2,2) priors are weak and proper for both action-indexed consequence rows.
rationales.policy_consequence_truth: Separated favorable-outcome rates make conjugate policy-consequence recovery identifiable.
rationales.expected_outcome_weights: The convex weights require world, learned policy consequence, and persistent root jointly to predict Y.
